compiled_state.title: [acli-integration.py]: _verify_created_issue silently branches to real Jira REST when JIRA_URL/USER/TOKEN are set -> tests pass/fail based on env
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 3371762eb2f58ebea385e4f139701f1a66afac3c
* **affected_file:** plugins/dso/scripts/acli-integration.py:399-418 (_verify_created_issue)
* **related_fix:** bug 1c68-24f4-3b8f-41c3 (transition_issue urllib seam fix)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

Tests that exercise create_issue should pass/fail identically regardless of whether JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, and JIRA_API_TOKEN are set in the environment. Test behavior must be determined solely by test mocks, not by ambient credentials.

#### Actual Behavior

_verify_created_issue (called from create_issue) contains an env-var-conditional branch at line 399-418: when JIRA_URL + JIRA_USER + JIRA_API_TOKEN are all non-empty, it calls urllib.request.urlopen directly (REST GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key}) instead of falling through to the subprocess get_issue path.

When Jira credentials are present in the local dev environment (e.g., JIRA_API_TOKEN=ATATT3x...), tests that only mock subprocess.run silently take the REST path. Before the network guard (bug 1c68), such tests "passed" by making real Jira REST calls. After the network guard is active, they fail with RuntimeError from socket.connect blocking.

The fix in test_acli_integration.py (part of bug 1c68 resolution) added _mock_urlopen_verify() helpers to intercept the urlopen call in those 7 tests. However, the production conditional branch is still the root cause: any future create_issue caller test that omits the urllib mock will silently switch behavior.

### 3. Action History and Workarounds

* Workaround applied: tests/scripts/test_acli_integration.py updated to mock urllib.request.urlopen for all create_issue tests via _mock_urlopen_verify() context manager.
* Root cause NOT fixed in production code — the env-conditional branch at acli-integration.py:399-418 remains.

### 4. Chronological Rationalization

The conditional was added to use REST GET (immediately consistent) instead of JQL search for verify-after-create. The JQL path has eventual-consistency lag. However, the env-var guard makes test isolation impossible without explicit urllib mocks in every caller test.

Possible production fix: always use the AcliClient instance's credentials (self.jira_url etc.) rather than os.environ, or extract a testable verify_created_issue(client, key) interface so tests can inject a mock client. Alternatively, make the REST path unconditional but require callers to always pass credentials explicitly.

### 5. Skills and Workflows

* Discovered during: bug 1c68-24f4-3b8f-41c3 isolation sweep (Part 2c)
* Scope: Jira integration / ACLI client layer
* Relevant code: plugins/dso/scripts/acli-integration.py lines 383-424 (_verify_created_issue)
